item.title: Group Preference Collapse in Personalized Multimodal Large Language Models
item.description: Fan Lyu, Wenqi Zhang, Joost van de Weijer Computer Vision Center, Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona Links: arXiv coming soon | Code coming soon | Dataset coming soon Figure: PrefMoE separates profile and preference representations, models preferences with shared prototypes and personalized residuals, and activates profile- and preference-aware LoRA experts through hierarchical MoE routing. Abstract Personalized multimodal large language models (MLLMs) aim to generate user-specific responses, but existing methods mainly rely on profile-level information and overlook diverse user preferences.
